ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) localized features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark base with discrete high-contrast white circular spots clustered near the median notch and on the right lobe. White pixel fringe along the trailing edge serrations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured angle of approximately 90 degrees and a vertical pixel depth of roughly 1/5th the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; amplitude variations between 5-20 pixels relative to the lobe's primary arc.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature with convex leading edges terminating in sharp, upwardly-tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular white rings (annular formations) distributed across the central fluke and right lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several white linear pixel disruptions; a long diagonal mark on the left lobe and multiple shorter, intersecting marks on the mid-to-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring including circular barnacle rosettes and linear rake marks; significant pixel-level damage to the distal tips showing irregular white clusters.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique white markings on the right lobe forming a pattern resembling the alphanumeric characters 'ANT' or 'ART'.
